name: FrenchModelVariant422_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant422_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 48-byte descriptor at data + 0x38 indexed by the request and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame, calling the veils from the descriptor start and the halo from phase 2, and drives the fade and return codes; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md; notes/overlays/french-model-variant422.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-405 images build the French header-422 source directly. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
